FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The once-majestic halls now echo with the hum of ancient machinery, as if the very fabric of time itself has been warped.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a man in his late 40s with a wild shock of white hair, sits upon his throne. His eyes gleam with a knowing intensity as he surveys his kingdom. The walls, once adorned with the proud coats of arms, now display a riotous tapestry of neon hues and glitching patterns.

EVERARD
(to his advisor, Lord Ravenswood)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era, one where our empire's aesthetic is reborn in the spirit of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

RAVENSWOOD
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But what of tradition?

EVERARD
(smirking)
Tradition is for the weak. We must forge a new path, one that blends the best of our heritage with the... (he waves his hand, as if conjuring the very essence of vaporwave)...dreamscapes of the future.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's courtyard, once a tranquil oasis, now throbs with the pulsing rhythms of a forgotten era. The sound of distant machinery and the chatter of courtiers blend with the sweet scent of blooming flowers, as if the very essence of nostalgia has been distilled into a heady elixir.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard rises from his throne, his eyes aglow with an otherworldly intensity. He summons his courtiers, and together they embark on a grand tour of the castle's hidden chambers.

EVERARD
(to his courtiers)
Behold! The future of our empire lies not in the grandeur of our past, but in the whispers of the machines.

As they explore the castle's depths, they stumble upon a hidden laboratory, where a team of courtiers toil over ancient contraptions and mysterious artifacts.

CUT TO:

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

The courtiers, led by the enigmatic Lady Astrid, work tirelessly to harness the power of the ancient machinery. They experiment with strange combinations of gears, wires, and crystals, as the air thickens with an electric anticipation.

LADY ASTRID
(to King Everard)
We are on the cusp of a revolution, Your Majesty. A revolution that will transform our empire into a realm of... (she pauses, her eyes sparkling with excitement)...wondrous possibility.

EVERARD
(smiling)
Then let us proceed, my dear Lady Astrid. Let us unleash the full fury of our proto-vaporwave upon the world.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The castle, once a bastion of tradition, now shines like a beacon of innovation. The air is alive with the hum of machinery, as if the very fabric of reality has been rewritten. The future is here, and it is... (the camera zooms in on a glitching pattern, as the words "THE END" appear in a font that seems to shift and writhe like a living thing)... vaporwave.
